collection.title: Bentley Continental Coupe 2005 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Bentley Continental Coupe 2005 to 2017 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slider arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
